name: Employees Page
description: Provides a company-scoped employee list with standard CRUD affordances.

fields.label: Employee Number
fields.tooltip: Unique employee identifier shown on employee records, payroll run lines, pay stubs, and payroll exports. Not used in numeric calculations.

fields.label: First Name
fields.tooltip: Employee first name. Used with Last Name to identify the employee on payroll run lines and pay stubs; not used in calculations.

fields.label: Last Name
fields.tooltip: Employee last name. Used with First Name to identify the employee on payroll run lines and pay stubs; not used in calculations.

fields.label: Email
fields.tooltip: Employee contact email for reference. Not used in payroll calculations.

fields.label: Department
fields.tooltip: Optional department label copied into payroll run lines for reporting and review. Not used in calculations.

fields.label: Job Title
fields.tooltip: Optional job title for the employee record. Not used in payroll calculations.

fields.label: Hire Date
fields.tooltip: Employee start date for reference and future eligibility rules. Not used in current payroll calculations.

fields.label: Status
fields.tooltip: Controls whether an employee is active, on leave, or inactive for payroll selection and review. Not used directly in numeric calculations.

fields.label: Annual Salary
fields.tooltip: Reference annual salary. Current payroll run calculations use Annual Pay Rate on each payroll line, divided by Pay Periods Per Year.

fields.label: Pay Type
fields.tooltip: Employee or contractor classification for payroll review. Not used directly in current numeric calculations.

fields.label: Pay Schedule
fields.tooltip: Default pay frequency for the employee. Not used directly in current payroll run formulas.

fields.label: Payroll State
fields.tooltip: State payroll jurisdiction reference for future tax rules. Not used directly in current payroll calculations.

fields.label: Payroll Profile
fields.tooltip: Hidden profile key. Defaults to Default and is intended to map this employee to a payroll settings profile in future payroll logic.

fields.label: Default Hours Per Period
fields.tooltip: Default hours for data entry. When copied to Total Hours on a payroll run line, it drives regular hours, overtime hours, regular pay, overtime pay, gross pay, taxes, benefits, net pay, and employer cost.

fields.label: Overtime Threshold
fields.tooltip: Employee-level overtime threshold reference. Payroll run formulas currently use the run header Overtime Threshold to split Total Hours into Regular Hours and OT Hours.

fields.label: Overtime Multiplier
fields.tooltip: Employee-level overtime multiplier reference. Payroll run formulas currently use the run header Overtime Multiplier when Overtime Hourly Rate is blank.

fields.label: Hourly Rate
fields.tooltip: Reference hourly rate. Current payroll run formulas use Regular Hourly Rate on each payroll line for hourly regular pay.

fields.label: Pay Rate Unit
fields.tooltip: Default pay unit copied to payroll lines. Determines whether the run uses hourly, weekly, monthly, or annual pay formulas for Regular Pay.

fields.label: Regular Hourly Rate
fields.tooltip: Default hourly rate copied to payroll lines. For hourly employees, Regular Pay = Regular Hours x Regular Hourly Rate.

fields.label: Overtime Hourly Rate
fields.tooltip: Default overtime hourly rate copied to payroll lines. If present, OT Pay = OT Hours x this rate; otherwise OT Rate = Regular Hourly Rate x Overtime Multiplier.

fields.label: Weekly Pay Rate
fields.tooltip: Default weekly pay rate copied to payroll lines. For weekly pay, Regular Pay = Weekly Pay Rate x Weeks In Period.

fields.label: Monthly Pay Rate
fields.tooltip: Default monthly pay rate copied to payroll lines. For monthly pay, Regular Pay = Monthly Pay Rate x Months In Period.

fields.label: Annual Pay Rate
fields.tooltip: Default annual pay rate copied to payroll lines. For annual pay, Regular Pay = Annual Pay Rate / Pay Periods Per Year.

fields.label: Salary Per Period
fields.tooltip: Reference salary amount per pay period. Not used by current payroll run formulas unless copied into another payroll line pay field.

fields.label: Employee Tax Rate
fields.tooltip: Employee-specific tax override reference. When copied to Employee Tax Rate Override on a payroll line, Employee Taxes = Gross Pay x this rate.

fields.label: Employer Tax Rate
fields.tooltip: Employer-specific tax override reference. When copied to Employer Tax Rate Override on a payroll line, Employer Taxes = Gross Pay x this rate.

fields.label: Benefit Deduction Per Period
fields.tooltip: Employee benefit deduction reference. When copied to Employee Benefit Flat Override on a payroll line, it is added to employee benefits deducted from gross pay.

fields.label: Employee Benefit Rate
fields.tooltip: Employee benefit percentage reference. When copied to Employee Benefit Rate Override on a payroll line, Employee Benefits include Gross Pay x this rate.

fields.label: Employer Benefit Cost Per Period
fields.tooltip: Employer benefit cost reference. When copied to Employer Benefit Flat Override on a payroll line, it is added to employer-paid benefits and total employer cost.

fields.label: Employer Benefit Rate
fields.tooltip: Employer benefit percentage reference. When copied to Employer Benefit Rate Override on a payroll line, Employer Benefits include Gross Pay x this rate.

fields.label: Workers Comp Rate
fields.tooltip: Workers compensation rate reference for future payroll cost rules. Not used directly in current payroll run formulas.

fields.label: Direct Deposit Enabled
fields.tooltip: Indicates whether direct deposit is enabled for the employee. Not used in payroll calculations.

fields.label: Notes
fields.tooltip: Internal employee notes. Not used in payroll calculations.
